blocks.text: Har algorithm har masle ke liye munasib nahi; intikhab raftar ki zaroorat, memory ke istemal aur data ki nauiyat par munhasir hai. Chhoti, be-tarteeb collection mein kitab dhoondne ke liye har kitab ek ek kar ke dekhein (linear search). Agar kitabein haroof-e-tahaji ki tarteeb mein hon to beech se shuru kar ke tay karein ke kis aadhe mein dhoondna hai (binary search).

blocks.prompt: Be-tarteeb list ke liye kaunsi search munasib hai, aur kyun?
blocks.explanation: Linear search, kyunke binary search sirf tarteeb wale data par chalti hai.

items: Munasibat: algorithm data ke mutabiq: be-tarteeb, linear search; tarteeb wala, binary search.
